headline: A 2022 law renames a Post Office building in Hagatña, Guam, after Atanasio Taitano Perez.
what_it_does: This law names the United States Postal Service facility at 223 West Chalan Santo Papa in Hagatña, Guam, the Atanasio Taitano Perez Post Office. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change postal services, rules, or costs.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on October 11, 2022.
